cases.message: What was the hardest technical challenge Johan faced?
cases.answer: Johan says the hardest technical challenge was flattening Pydantic JSON Schemas so they could be used with Gemini, which rejected schemas containing $ref, $defs, anyOf or const. He built a resolver that transforms the schema into plain JSON that the model accepts, enabling reliable structured output. He also tackled automatic failover between LLM providers, creating a routing layer with per-provider concurrency control and token usage tracking.
